note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped DSperate binary. A fresh clone of this repository plus Docker is the whole toolchain: no sibling checkout, no locally built image, no opaque downloaded binary. DSperate is built from the pinned commit with the pak's patches in `patches/`, applied in order; each is locked by sha256 and the build refuses a mismatch. `make standalone` refuses a source archive or artifact whose sha256 does not match this file.

build.sdl2: device-provided libSDL2-2.0.so.0, linked dynamically; the MLP1 ships 2.28.5 built with its Wayland video driver
build.wayland_note: The toolchain sysroot's SDL2 2.28.5 is built without its Wayland driver, so its SDL_config.h leaves SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_WAYLAND undefined and SDL_syswm.h hides SDL_SysWMinfo's Wayland fields. Defining the macro for this build exposes those fields without changing the toolchain, and is what lets the intended dmabuf tier compile. The public union reserves the fields' space regardless, and the binary links the device's Wayland-capable SDL at runtime. The build fails if the probe or display_wl.cpp does not confirm the real tier.
build.source_date_note: The pinned v3.0.3 commit's committer timestamp.
build.cheevos_version_note: Passed explicitly because a shallow checkout has no tags for upstream's `git describe` fallback.
build.pgo_note: A fresh aarch64 profile is trained with this pak's own toolchain (Buildroot GCC 12.3.0) and these flags against the patched v3.0.3 source by standalone/pgo-train.sh, so its fingerprint matches the release build. Upstream v3.0.3 ships profiles for other GCC versions only, which this toolchain refuses.
build.vulkan_note: Off on purpose. v3 builds a Vulkan dma-buf presenter and an optional GPU 3D raster when vulkan/vulkan.h is found, and silently builds stubs when it is not. The pinned toolchain image carries no Vulkan headers, so the option is pinned off rather than left to whatever a build host happens to have installed. That keeps 2.1.1's CPU scaling: the MLP1 has a Vulkan loader and Mali ICD, so turning the presenter on is a separate, device-measured change. v3's other presenter, the RGA through V4L2 mem2mem, declines on the MLP1, whose stock kernel exposes the RGA only as /dev/rga.

pgo.scenes: mlbis sm64 etody dbori meteos gsdd nsmb
pgo.note: Trained with this pak's toolchain and flags against the patched v2.1.1 tree, so the fingerprint matches the release build. The scenes are upstream's recorded replays; `st` was skipped because its save state is for another ROM revision, which the loader refuses. The headless frontend is the training build; the SDL frontend, rcheevos and the reference kernels are never trained. Verify with -DDSPERATE_PGO_STRICT=ON: 0 unexpected objects without a profile and 0 coverage mismatches.

version.note: Locked --version identity. The build exports DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION and DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT, and cmake/version.cmake prefers them over git, so a source archive without git and a patched checkout git would call dirty both report v3.0.3 (f5fa35e).

patches.note: Adds --cache-root-only, --single-rom and --inspect-cart, backed by cart.cache_root_only and cart.single_nds, plus unsafe entry-path rejection. Rebased onto v3.0.3, whose tree-wide comment rewrite and CLI parser moves left the logic unchanged; the policy features are still absent upstream, so they are carried. The pak's wrapper pins the extraction cache to its own root, requires exactly one image entry, and sizes the cache before launch. See PROVENANCE.md.

Keeps checked flush, fsync, close and rename for battery-save and save-state writes, plus checked firmware-override flush and close. Upstream v3.0.3 still writes these unchecked. Retains upstream save loading, chip detection and mismatch backups. See PROVENANCE.md.

Stops the host-resume lid pulse on a device with no lid switch. The old code fabricated a lid close/open cycle on every resume; games that blank their screens on lid-close and restore them only on an open they saw coming (Contra 4) stayed black. The pulse now only fires for a lid already believed closed. See PROVENANCE.md.

Makes --version report the lock's tag and commit deterministically. Upstream's generator derives the tag from git describe and the commit from git rev-parse, so a source archive without git says unknown and a patched checkout says <hash>-dirty. This patch prefers DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION and DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT when the packager sets them, and leaves ordinary git development unchanged.

The standalone-ra-account-v1 consumer. Adds the shared contract classifier and marker (verbatim with the Flycast consumer and the leaf-contracts reference), the managed-account bridge with its own checked token writer (same-directory temporary, write, fsync, close, rename, each checked; the revision is accepted only after it), and the native login wiring (import, one password retry, sign-out). Captures and scrubs UMRK_RA_ACCOUNT_* at startup; an explicit cheevos.enabled = false or --no-cheevos wins over a managed account; bridge failures reach the native pop-up path even with toasts off; an unmanaged sign-in stays session-only as upstream. Never writes a password or token to a log or argv.

device.checked: 2026-09-15 on an MLP1 running Leaf 0.12.0-beta.1 (LoongOS rootfs; glibc 2.38, SDL 2.28.5, both matching the toolchain sysroot for the core runtime libraries)
